text.en: This Order may be cited as the Currency and Monetary (Amendment) Order, . of section 33 of S 16/04.

Section 33 of the Currency and Monetary Order, 2004, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended by repealing subsections (1) and (2) and by substituting the following 2 new subsections therefor - "(1) The accounts of the Board shall be audited annually by

(a) the Auditor General; or

(b) any person who has been authorised to perform the duties by the Companies Act (Chapter 39) to be performed by an auditor, who shall be appointed annually by the Board.

(2) Where the accounts of the Board have been audited by a person under subsection (l)(b), they may be verified by the Auditor General before they are submitted to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan pursuant to section 34(3).". of section 34.

Section 34 of the principal Order is amended by repealing subsections (1) and (2) and by substituting the following 3 new subsections therefor"Ill Within 6 months of the close of its financial year, the Board shall and forward to the Minister an annual report comprising - (a} the operations of the Board during that year;

(b) a copy of the accounts certified by the Auditor General or any person authorised under section 33(1)(bj. 12) The accounts certified by the Auditor General or any person authorised section 33(1)(bJ to be published in the Gazette. (2AJ The Minister shall as soon as practicable cause the annual report to be submitted to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.". Made this 15th. day of Rejab, 1428 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of July, 2007 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
